named_events.loss_description: Discussed historically; prompted extensive review of catastrophe exposure and analysis of plant locations; cited as not insured for earthquake and tsunami in the conventional market.
Mentioned as the only significant core melt nuclear event paid by the insurance market historically.
Cited historic largest insured windstorm loss to date relating to a spares warehouse on a nuclear site; unit undamaged.
Increase in net incurred claims is driven by deterioration to a Scandinavian loss reserve on the Nuclear Property class.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1176 opened 2023 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 38.646m. During 2023 the Syndicate recorded a release of prior year technical reserves totalling GBP 7.0m (a c.18.1% reduction relative to opening gross claims outstanding), driven by favourable claims development primarily in the nuclear property and nuclear liability portfolios - notably settlements on reserves attached to the 2019 and 2020 underwriting years. The movement is described as a release of technical reserves and is recorded explicitly in the Movement in prior year's provision note.
raw_causal_phrases: During the year, the Syndicate released GBP 7.0m of technical reserves in respect of prior years (2022: GBP 9.8m) arising from the nuclear property and nuclear liability classes (2022: from the nuclear property and nuclear liability classes).
Further certain reserved losses which were attached to the 2019 and 2020 underwriting years have been settled well within reserves leading to an increased profit and overall negative net loss ratio.

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year movement figure (GBP 7.0m released) is reported in the Movement in prior year's provision note as an explicit amount but the note is narrative in form and does not show a detailed gross/reinsurer's-share split for this prior-year movement. I have taken the reported GBP 7.0m as the gross movement because it is presented in the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note. Where LOB-level prior-year movements were not quantified, amounts are left null. The claims development triangle is present and was used as a cross-check; the triangle is presented in GBP 000s.
